ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Neptune

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1804159901000}, the Moon is still in {S:9} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Neptune brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Neptune brings inspiration and sensitivity. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.
